messages:
maria (eng-platform): Heads-up: we need to finalize the telemetry contract for private/VPC on-prem exporter so Console dashboards can show per-tenant health + quota usage. Who can own the schema?
sam (eng-infra): I can take ownership of the runtime producer changes (agent -> exporter payload). Need to know required labels and PII rules.
alex (product): From a UX side we want: tenant id (hashed), agent_version, region, exporter_type (pull/push), last_handshake_ms, failed_batches_1h, bytes_egressed, and kms_key_id (last 5 chars masked). Filterable by customer in Console.
ravi (eng-ml): Make sure we surface inference-related metrics too: active_streams, avg_infer_latency_ms, kv_cache_hit_ratio. These are important for cost dashboards.
jon (security): PII rules: tenant id must be HMAC-256 hashed before leaving the VPC. No raw IPs or hostnames. KMS audit hook events should be an event stream not payload field; send a separate metric/event: redwood.kms.key_usage with label key_suffix (last4) and operation.
maria (eng-platform): Agreed on HMAC. Let's standardize metric names and label sets now. Proposal (working):
```
redwood.private.export.handshake_latency_ms {tenant_hmac, region, agent_version, exporter_type}
redwood.private.export.failed_batches_total {tenant_hmac, region, reason_category}
redwood.private.export.egress_bytes_total {tenant_hmac, region}
redwood.private.kms.key_usage_total {key_suffix, operation} // emitted by KMS hook forwarder
redwood.private.agent.heartbeat_ts {tenant_hmac, agent_version}
redwood.private.infer.avg_latency_ms {tenant_hmac, model_family}
```
Please poke holes.
sam (eng-infra): Looks good. Two infra notes: 1) exporter will only be allowed to egress to our push endpoint on 443; customers must open outbound to our IP ranges — we should add a short bullet to the onboarding doc. 2) batching config: default chunk_size=1000 events or 4MB whichever first; need fields for batch_count and batch_size_bytes.
alex (product): Add batch success/failure rate to the dashboard: a rate-series and histogram for batch_size_bytes. Also need a canary toggle in Console to enable the richer telemetry for selected tenants.
maria (eng-platform): For the Console dashboard we want: "Private Export Overview" with columns: tenant (filtered by owner), last_handshake, heartbeat_age, failed_batches_1h, egress_bytes_24h, agent_version, kms_key_rotation_age. Drilldown should link to raw events view.
ravi (eng-ml): One more: emit kv_cache_hit_ratio at model-shard granularity if possible (label model_shard). If not, at least model_family.
jon (security): On KMS: we will forward CloudTrail-like KMS events from customer-managed KMS via the agent only if customers opt-in in the agent config. The forwarded events must be signed and have a seq number. We will record events in audit-log store, and emit redwood.private.kms.key_usage_total to metrics with aggregated counts.
maria (eng-platform): Rollout plan idea: 1) schema PRs in runtime + infra repos; 2) ship agent producer behind feature flag; 3) canary to 5 tenants for 48h; 4) enable Console UX and quota panels for canary tenants; 5) backfill 30d for canary tenants for dashboard continuity. Thoughts?
sam (eng-infra): Sounds right. Need to coordinate firewall docs with Support. Also I'll add a small e2e test that simulates blocked egress and ensures agent retries with exponential backoff and records failure_reason=egress_block.
jon (security): Need a short threat analysis in the PR: what if a misconfigured agent leaks tenant_hmac and KMS key_suffix mapping? Mitigation: store key mapping only in customer VPC; we only forward key_suffix last4; rotate hmac keys on rotation.
alex (product): For quotas: define per-tenant export quota (events/day) and a soft quota alert in Console. We should show usage % and an override path for SEs.
maria (eng-platform): Action items: sam -> runtime producer PR (+batch fields) by EOD Friday; jon -> KMS hook design doc link and threat analysis; ravi -> list of model metrics to include; alex -> Console mockups (filters + canary toggle). I'll open a cross-team PR checklist in the eng-platform repo.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: metric-schema-validator v0.9 -> staging (ci-job 4821) :rocket:
sam (eng-infra): Also note: exporter handshake latency needs to be measured from agent side and server side. Add label side={agent,server}. Otherwise we get skew.
maria (eng-platform): Good catch. Update schema accordingly. Final ask: owners post PR links here and paste the new metric JSON schema snippet when ready. :thumbsup:
